meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找出之前会话的解法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从过往会话中找回解法与结论
copy.tagline_en: Search past sessions for prior solutions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to dig up past session solutions and decisions

howto.what: 装上此技能后，当你询问以往工作时，Claude 会搜索跨会话记忆库，先返回带编号的匹配列表，再用时间线查看上下文，最后获取所选记录的完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问起之前会话或过去做过的工作，如“上次怎么解决的？”、“之前处理过吗？”等时触发。

say.text: 上次我们是怎么解决登录超时的？
say.note: Claude 会搜索过去的记录并返回相关结果。

say.text: 帮我查一下之前关于认证的讨论。
say.note: Claude 会从跨会话记忆中检索匹配项。

say.text: 上周我们修复了哪些 bug？
say.note: Claude 会按日期筛选并列出 bug 修复记录。

howto.what_en: After install, when you ask about previous work, Claude searches cross-session memory: first returns an ID list, then views context via timeline, and finally fetches full details for chosen IDs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions or past work, such as 'how did we solve X last time?' or 'did we already handle this before?'

say_en.text: How did we fix the login timeout last time?
say_en.note: Claude searches past sessions and shows matching results.

say_en.text: Can you look up our earlier discussion about auth?
say_en.note: Claude returns matching discussion from memory.

say_en.text: Which bugs did we fix last week?
say_en.note: Claude filters by date and lists bug-fix records.
